title: Ribin avatar item, cosmetic schema 1.0.0 (32x32 text grid)

planning.guidance: Plan wearable avatar items for a 32x32 pixel avatar seen from the front. Each item is one object with a large, simple silhouette that stays readable at 32x32: no small text, no thin lines, no scene. Spread the pack over the hat, top and accessory categories. Use rarity to grade effort: common items are simple and free, rare and epic items add a detail, legendary items are the showpieces; keep about half of the pack common or rare. Ids are short English snake_case names; titles are short display names of at most 40 characters.

categories.description: headwear covering the top of the head: caps, beanies, crowns, antlers, headbands
categories.framing: the headwear alone, wider than tall, as seen on top of a head
categories.review: The export shows the headwear alone, in the top rows of the avatar grid.

categories.description: upper-body clothing seen from the shoulders down: sweaters, jackets, scarves worn over a top
categories.framing: the garment seen from the front, collar at the top, wide shoulders, with a bold pattern on the chest
categories.review: The export keeps only the shoulders and upper chest of the garment, cropped as it sits under an avatar head at the bottom of the grid; judge it as a torso seen from the front, not as a whole garment, and accept a simplified pattern.

categories.description: an extra item drawn over the face or the neck
categories.framing: the accessory alone, wide and short
categories.review: The export shows the accessory alone, small, where it sits on the face or the neck.

generation.style_prefix: Pixel-art game sprite of a single wearable avatar item, chunky pixels, bold dark outline, flat cel shading with two tones per colour, front view, centered, large simple silhouette filling most of the frame.
generation.composition: One object only, no character, no head, no mannequin, no hands, no text, no frame.
generation.background: Flat uniform solid magenta background (#FF00FF) everywhere around the object, with no gradient, no shadow, no glow, no halo and no light effect around any part of the object.
generation.avoid: Do not use magenta or pink inside the object.

judge.prompt: You review one generated pixel-art avatar item, shown enlarged on a grey checkerboard. Score from 0 to 10 how well it reads as the expected item at this size: a single clear object, recognizable silhouette, clean edges, no stray pixels or background remnants, no pink fringe. Set pass to true when the score is 6 or more and the object is the expected one.

pricing.note: Suggested price only, from the Ribin shop price grid; nothing is put on sale.
